dialogues.jp: こんなにも眠いというのはどういうことだ。
dialogues.en: I felt more like taking a nap instead.
dialogues.text: I felt more like taking a nap instead.

dialogues.jp:
昨日、そんなに夜更かししたっけ？　昨日は実
に健全に過ごしたような気がするが……。
dialogues.en: Did I stay up that late last night? I slept pretty well...
dialogues.text: Did I stay up that late last night? I slept pretty well...

dialogues.jp:
どうも今日は、眠いようだ。腹が減って死ぬ確
率より、睡眠不足で死ぬ確率の方が高いような
気がする。
dialogues.en:
For today, I will rest. The chances of dying from sleep
deprivation are higher than that of dying from hunger.
dialogues.text:
For today, I will rest. The chances of dying from sleep
deprivation are higher than that of dying from hunger.

dialogues.jp: 俺の胃袋よ。夜までガマンできるな？
dialogues.en: My stomach, just hold on till nighttime, won't you?
dialogues.text: My stomach, just hold on till nighttime, won't you?

dialogues.jp:
腹が減っていても、何か食べたいと思っても、
眠りたいという時がある。
dialogues.en:
Although my stomach was grumbling, there are times where
sleep takes precedence.
dialogues.text:
Although my stomach was grumbling, there are times where
sleep takes precedence.

dialogues.en: That was the feeling I had today.
dialogues.text: That was the feeling I had today.
